title: Singapore dollar to Indonesian rupiah, daily since 1999
description: Rupiah per Singapore dollar and Singapore dollars per 1,000,000 rupiah, each working day since 1999: MAS's noon rate where MAS publishes one, and earlier days from the source named on each row.
question: What is the Singapore dollar worth in rupiah, on any working day since 1999?

fields.name: date
fields.meaning: The day the rate is for.

fields.name: idr_per_sgd
fields.meaning: How many rupiah one Singapore dollar buys (the inverse of the next column, kept to six decimals).

fields.name: sgd_per_1000000_idr
fields.meaning: Singapore dollars per 1,000,000 rupiah, the way MAS quotes it.

fields.name: source
fields.meaning: Which figure the row is: ECB = the ECB's euro reference rates, crossed (before MAS's daily record); MAS = MAS, as of noon.

sources.terms: MAS Terms of Use of Datasets
